title: Leaving Basie in December 1954: appendix operation
summary: He left Basie when his appendix burst and he was hospitalised.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, then you left Basie, it says, 23 December, 1954.
I had appendix. I had to go in the hospital.
Hit me That night, the 22nd or 23rd, I was
in the hospital. And they had to operate on me that next day.
So that laid you up a bit.
Oh, yeah, I was in there about ten, 15 days.
For Appendix, you know, because when they cut me and raised it up, they bust it.
No, they caught it just in time. At the time it busted, they put the tubes in there and started running it out.
The doctor came in, fussing at me because I stopped him from going on his vacation.
No, Dr. Green was his name.

I know who you're talking about. No,
